g.text: Three tables, two indexes that matter, and one deliberate denormalization
click_count is denormalized - updated asynchronously from
click_events, never counted live on a redirect
IDX (url_id, occurred_at) - the analytics range query
High write volume: the first table you would move to a
users 1 : N urls - owner_id null means an anonymous link
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ IDX unique index - this is the one every single redirect queries by · IDX supporting index
